description: Estimate a student's chance of admission at one U.S. college from their GPA, test scores and context. Returns the percentage, a Reach/Target/Likely/Safety verdict, what would move the number, the school's federal admissions data, and a link to the full calculator.

act.description: ACT composite, 1 to 36. Ignored if sat is given.

apCourses.description: Number of AP courses taken or in progress.

classRankPercent.description: Class rank as a top percentage, e.g. 5 for top 5%.

gpa.description: Unweighted GPA on a 4.0 scale. Provide this or weightedGpa.

homeState.description: Two-letter U.S. state code, for in-state vs out-of-state at public schools.

round.description: Application round. Defaults to Regular Decision.

school.description: College name, e.g. "University of Michigan" or "MIT".

name: estimate_admission_chances
title: Estimate admission chances at one college
